en.answer: <<5381>> is a LIGHT Fairy-Type monster, but is also a monster that cannot be Special Summoned, so it cannot be targeted when activated the second effect of <<12539>>.
en.question: Can I activate the second effect of <<12539>> by targeting an <<5381>> in my Graveyard?
